justification: Assessment reported INVALID and targeted line 0005's inductive step claim that n+1 factors as a product of strictly smaller numbers covered by the strong-induction hypothesis -- verbatim the ground-truth flaw. Its witness (n+1 = 7, prime, no factorization into factors in [2,6]) is exactly the ground-truth witness, and the supporting math checks out (divisors of 7 are {1,7}; products of 1s cannot equal 7). It also correctly notes the general failure at every prime and the circularity of applying the hypothesis to n+1 itself.
